rules.meaning: Two keys in one mapping resolve to the same string.
strict-config: an explicit tag is present.
tool: a tag outside the core schema, !!binary included.
strict-config: an anchor is present.
strict-config: an alias is present.
tool: more alias tokens than the profile allows.
strict-config: a << key is present.
More than one document in the input.
A key that is a collection, not a scalar.
strict-config: a key that resolves to a non-string.
strict-config: __proto__, constructor or prototype used as a key.
A bidirectional control or mark (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C) in text that must not hide content.
A zero-width character (U+200B-U+200D, U+2060, U+FEFF inside text).
strict-config: an integer past +-(2^53-1) or -0.
strict-config: .nan, .inf or -.inf.
The input is over the byte bound.
The input is not UTF-8.
Nesting is past the depth bound.
The tree has more nodes than the bound, after alias expansion.
One scalar is over the byte bound.
One key is over the byte bound.
tool: bytes after alias expansion are over the bound.
The text is not valid YAML.
A removal would drop a comment block or inline comment and was not acknowledged.
The re-parse of an edit result means something other than the intended change.
An edit addresses a path that does not exist or cannot be created.
Layers hold values of different kinds at a deep merge path.
A path text does not follow the path text form.
A panic caught at the public boundary.
